decisions.reason: The flagship digital anamnesis product line fits the firm's digital-practice direction, and demand for digital patient intake has grown, so the option has proven its value and deserves further commitment.
The education institute builds on the firm's training resources at low incremental cost and supports customer retention, so keeping it open is cheap and worthwhile.
Remote screen-sharing support is cheap to maintain and gained value through remote work in the pandemic, so it stays as part of the support infrastructure.
The analytics dashboard extends the core software at modest cost and fits the efficiently managed practice vision, while its prospects are still uncertain enough to keep the option open.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages existing offerings, so it costs little to keep, though it could be rebranded or folded into other offers.

The job and listing portal is distant from the core and its value is still unproven, but it was only mentioned on the site and is likely cheap to run, so the option remains open for now despite a substantial risk of abandonment.
